By usage of our Website and/or our mobile application you expressly permit Offertag to access such information for one or more purposes deemed fit by Offertag
Cookies

Our Website and/or our mobile application utilises "Cookies" and Web server logs to collect information about how our Website and/or our mobile application is used. Cookies are small pieces of information that are stored on your computer's hard drive by your browser. Cookies are only read by the server that places them, and are unable to inter alia run programs on your computer, plant viruses or harvest your personal information. Cookies allow Web servers to recognise your computer each time you return to our web site and/or our mobile application including the date and time of visits, the pages viewed, time spent at our Website and/or our mobile application, and the Websites visited just before and just after our Website and/or our mobile application, verify your registration or password information (in case of registered users) during a particular session so that you do not have to input your password multiple times as you navigate the site, and suggest products or services that may interest you. This information is collected on an aggregate basis. None of this information is associated with you as an individual.

Most web browsers automatically accept cookies. You can control how and whether cookies will be accepted by your browser by changing the options on your web browser or using certain software programs. Offertag fully supports your right to block any unwanted Internet activity, especially that of unscrupulous websites. However, blocking Offertag cookies may disable certain features on our Website and/or our mobile application may affect your overall shopping experience with us.
When and how do we collect the Information?
We collect information from you for various purposes including but not limited to the following:
1) Member Registration:

In case you wish to become a registered member of our Website and/or our mobile application, you will be required to share some of your personal details such as your name, e-mail address, mobile number, password, and password validation. This information is collected on the registration form for several reasons including but not limited to the following:
Personal Identification Purposes;
If Necessary, Customising The Content Of This Website and/or our mobile application To Strive To Meet Your Specific Needs
2) Automatic Logging of Session Data

Offertag automatically log generic information about your computer's connection to the Internet, which is called "session data", that is anonymous and not linked to any personal information. Session data consists of information such as the IP address, OS, type of browser being used by you and the activities conducted by you on our Website and/or our mobile application. An IP address is a number that lets computers attached to the internet, such as our web servers, know where to send data back to the user, such as the pages of the site the user wishes to view. It helps us diagnose problems with our servers and lets us better administer our systems. Although such information does not identify any visitor personally, it is possible to determine from an IP address a visitor's Internet Service Provider (ISP), and the approximate geographic location of his or her point of connectivity.
3) Cookies

The use of cookies is very common on the Internet and Offertag's use of cookies is similar to that prevailing in the industry from to time. No personal information about you is gathered or stored in the cookies placed by our Website and/or our mobile application and, as a result, none can be passed on to any third party.

This website uses “Google Analytics” to help analyse how user uses this website. Google Analytics uses “cookies” to collect standard internet log information and visitor behaviour information in an anonymous form. The anonymous information generated by the cookies about your use of this website (including your IP address) is transmitted to Google. Offertag collects your IP address only for the purpose of determining geographic location of visits and does not link or seek to link IP address with the identity of the computer user.

The collected information is then processed to compile statistical reports on website activity. The reports are used to evaluate aggregate visitor usage to optimise the content of the website and/or mobile application and only to serve our Users effectively. Google analytics does not compile any personally identifiable data and all the activity on our website falls within the bound of Google Analytics Terms of Service.
4) Other

We may add or enhance products/services available on our Website and/or our mobile application from time to time. We will use the information you provide in this regard to facilitate the products/service requested to the extent these products/services are used by you.

Additionally, please note that we may not be able to delete data that has been shared with third-party services, such as analytics or advertising providers. In these cases, we will take reasonable steps to ensure that your data is no longer used for these purposes.

You have the right to access, modify, or delete your data at any time. To do so, please use the 'My Profile' section within the App or Profile section in the website.
